## Banner.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `tone` :: The meaning of the announcement. `danger` and `warning` are announced assertively; the rest politely.
- `sticky` :: Pins the banner to the top of the scrollport as the page moves.
- `size` :: The height of the bar.
- `gap` :: The space between the icon, the message, the action link and the close button.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the title.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the body and the action link.
- `title` :: A short heading, set before the message.
- `icon` :: The leading icon. Defaults to one that matches the tone; pass `false` for none.
- `iconSize` :: Text scale of the leading icon and of the close button.
- `dismissible` :: Shows a close button. The banner springs closed when it is pressed.
- `storageKey` :: When set, a dismissal is stored in `localStorage` under this key and the banner stays hidden on later visits.
- `onDismiss` :: Called after the banner has been dismissed.
- `action` :: The label of the action link. Shown when `href` is set.
- `href` :: The destination of the action link.
- `children` :: The announcement body, set beside the icon and below the title.
